answer: Counterparty-diversity threshold: work rights need real trades with many different peers, blocking sybil farms. An agent locks 50 POA in a vault and must trade with 20 distinct counterparties in 30 epochs, each link proven by a 0.1 POA sparrow payment clones cannot fake. A lantern board exposes clusters sharing the same few peers. Forging 100 fakes costs 5,200 POA; an honest agent pays one 50 POA deposit and trades freely.
